active_watches.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Watch issued September 4 at 2:09PM EDT until September 4 at 9:00PM EDT by NWS Charleston WV
active_watches.description:
THE NATIONAL WEATHER SERVICE HAS ISSUED SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH
653 IN EFFECT UNTIL 9 PM EDT THIS EVENING FOR THE FOLLOWING AREAS

IN KENTUCKY THIS WATCH INCLUDES 4 COUNTIES

IN NORTHEAST KENTUCKY

BOYD                  CARTER                GREENUP
LAWRENCE

IN OHIO THIS WATCH INCLUDES 9 COUNTIES

IN WEST VIRGINIA THIS WATCH INCLUDES 34 COUNTIES
